message.content: The landing page features a clean, professional color scheme dominated by white backgrounds, vibrant green accents for primary actions and headings, and dark gray text for readability. The layout quality appears high, with a well-structured header containing navigation links and a prominent hero section that effectively showcases the "Trust Passport" verification card alongside compelling copy. No obvious visual defects are present—elements maintain consistent spacing, typography is crisp, and the grid-based background adds subtle visual interest without cluttering the interface. There are no overlapping elements or broken styling issues visible; all components including buttons, icons, and text blocks appear properly aligned and rendered. The overall design conveys trust and modernity through its minimalist aesthetic, strategic use of whitespace, and cohesive green-and-white palette that reinforces the brand's identity as a secure verification platform.
